_comment: Tier 1 locate set, 30 questions. Every citation re-opened against the tree at HEAD 89c049fd on 2026-08-07, after L0 landed (AGENTS.md map fix, CONVENTIONS.md, clippy -D warnings, dead-code sweep). Owner ratifies before the baseline run.
_grain: crate | module | file | symbol - the granularity at which an answer earns full credit
_scoring: Every question is scored as one number in [0.00, 1.00], two decimals. 1.00 = matches `expect` at the stated `grain`, or an equivalent statement of it. 0.00 = wrong crate/module/file, or contradicted by `citation`, or a value `notes` pins at 0.00. Any value between is available and `notes` states the ones this key fixes; a value `notes` fixes overrides any fraction the grader would otherwise compute. Where `notes` fixes no intermediate value, score the fraction of required parts answered, or 1.00/0.00 for a single-part question. See papers/grade-tier1.md.
_personas: omit the field to mean all of blind, docs, tree, rustdoc, owner
_owner_subset_note: The fixed subset the owner answers instead of all 30: one per coverage area plus two controls (t1-005, t1-029). Keep at least one control - an owner run with no control cannot distinguish 'the owner knows everything' from 'the questions are too easy'.

questions.question: Which module owns the terminal and windowing runtime that draws the in-game NOVA OS screens?

questions.why_this_question: The name says hud. It is a 14,274-line windowing runtime across nova_os/, nova_os_map/, nova_os_ship/ and nova_os_pointer_rig.rs. Directly tests a folder name that lies. A wrong answer at baseline proves the tree does not disclose where the biggest single feature in the crate lives.
questions.notes: 0.50 for naming crates/nova_gameplay/src/hud/ without the nova_os subtree. Naming the crate nova_os is 0.00 however close it looks - that crate holds no drawing code (see t1-009). DOCS CUE (L0): CONVENTIONS.md rule 4 uses `use crate::hud::nova_os::shell::*;` as its bad-import example, which discloses the hud/nova_os/ path. A docs 1.00 here is doc-cued; weigh blind and tree as the structure signal.
